meta.title: Act 3 — Sky: The Cirran Shelf
meta.note: The five main quests of Act 3 (game-story.md §4, issue #145). Act 3 is PART OF THE OPEN WORLD, the way Act 2 is (issue #144): the Shelf is the open world's sky, its towns are CARRIERS that roam above it, and there is no `cirrus` zone. What `sky-revealed` opens is the BALLOON — the means of getting up — not the geography.
meta.loading: Boot-loaded (see bootstrapContent in main.ts), for the same reason story-sea is: a carried town must exist when the world is built, because the island that carries it is built with the world. The flag-gated load recorded in issue #261 was the zone-era answer and went with the zone.
meta.the-seam: The ascent is offered at the WRECK on Gullspire by Corwin Vane's sea placement (story-sea.json — the same man, the balloon he patched) and closed by his Skyhaven placement (core.json). Boarding is a `ride` fact the balloon emits, `reach-skyhaven` the arrival replay every town-arrival objective gets. The balloon runs both ways from the first day it is moored: Act 4 stages out of the Encampment.

data._seam: THE ACT 2 -> ACT 3 SEAM, receiving half. The prerequisite alone is the door for THIS quest; everything else in the sky tests sky-revealed. Given at the wreck, closed on the deck: giver and turnIn are the two placements of one pilot.
